image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage comic book cover titled 'CREEPY' (partially visible as 'CRE...'). The cover features grotesque, horror-themed artwork in a classic pulp style. Prominent elements include a large, screaming face with glasses and long hair in the foreground, a woman in a yellow dress floating or falling in the upper right holding a gun, and another character's head in the bottom right. The background depicts a stylized cityscape. Text elements include the title, price box ('15¢'), and teaser text on the left side.
